title: Digital-arrest call (Hindi), recorded
description: An AI scammer (a Gemini script-writer reacting to the decoy's actual words, voiced by Gemini text-to-speech, all fictional) phones the live decoy. Everything on the right, from the transcript to the confirmed UPI ID and bank account, was produced by the real pipeline during this call. Both voices are exactly what each side produced; the pauses between turns are shortened, and the measured reply delay is in the stats. The spoken Hindi is shown as an English transcript.

strain.paymentMethod: UPI transfer or bank account transfer (NEFT/IMPS)
steps: Falsely identify as a CBI officer alleging that an illegal parcel was booked using the victim's Aadhaar card.
Threaten the victim with an active arrest warrant and insist on strict secrecy.
Demand an urgent refundable security deposit for official verification.
Provide bank and UPI details under a commercial name for money transfer.
Pressurize the victim to transfer money within thirty minutes under threat of immediate home arrest.
redFlags: A caller claiming to be from the police or CBI demands money to clear your name.
You are ordered to stay on the call and keep the conversation secret from your family.
You are pressured to transfer funds urgently to a private company bank account.
scriptExcerpts: मैं सीबीआई साइबर क्राइम ब्रांच से इंस्पेक्टर [NAME], बैच नंबर [BATCH_NUMBER] बात कर रहा हूं। आपके आधार कार्ड से बुक हुआ एक पार्सल जब्त हुआ है...
घबराइए मत सर, अगर आप निर्दोष हैं तो तुरंत सत्यापन के लिए [AMOUNT] की रिफंडेबल राशि भेजनी होगी।
सर, समय कम है। 30 मिनट में ट्रांसफर करके स्क्रीनशॉट भेजिए, वरना टीम आपके घर पहुंचेगी।
